Là mã số gắn liền với mỗi kiện hàng, là.en: As a digital code attached to each package, is the sole of the cargo to make the control process easy. At the sender's side, the receiver helps to determine where his freight route has reached, whether it follows the plan. On the side of the transport unit will help control the number of goods, the most accurate classification.
Là mã số gắn liền với mỗi kiện hàng, là.zh: 作为每个包件的附着数字编码,是货物中唯一能够使控制过程变得容易的. 在发件人一方,接收器帮助确定其货运路线已经到达何处,是否遵循了计划. 运输单位一侧将帮助控制货物数量,最准确的分类.

Mã vận đơn được hiểu theo cách đơn giản.en: The single shipping code is understood in the simplest way is a series of characters attached to each package of goods to classify them. This is a very important type of code in transportation, logistic activities. The single code was attached to the cargo packages that were requested to be sent, which were stored on the system to serve as a base for related activities.
Mã vận đơn được hiểu theo cách đơn giản.zh: 单运码最简单的理解是每包货物上附加的一系列字符来分类. 这是运输、后勤活动方面非常重要的守则。 单一编码附在要求发送的货包上,这些货包存放在系统中,作为相关活动的基地.

Mỗi mã vận đơn của đơn vị giao hàng tiết.en: Each single code of the single delivery unit will be a series of notations consisting of numbers and letters, including: the signature of Shop, the province code, storage code and delivery routes; the single number consists of 9 digits. The singles sent may be identical in a few shop codes, provinces, archives but the last nine digits will never coincide.
Mỗi mã vận đơn của đơn vị giao hàng tiết.zh: 单次送货单位的每个单次代码将是一系列由数字和字母组成的注释,包括:商店的签名,省代码,存储代码和送货路线;单次号码由9位数字组成. 寄出的单曲在几家商店代码,省份,档案中可能完全相同,但最后的九位数字永远不会重合.

Ngoài mã vận đơn thì trên phiếu gửi hàng.en: In addition to the single-volume code, on the freight ticket there will be a barcode, which is a form of monocode and is equally valid.
Ngoài mã vận đơn thì trên phiếu gửi hàng.zh: 除单卷码外,货运票上还会有条码,条码是一种单码形式,同样有效.

Nếu chỉ nhìn vào một mã vận đơn thì bạn.en: If you look at a single-code, can you confirm that it's a single order due to transportation savings delivery? How do we look into accurate savings delivery?
